news.headline: Teradyne (NASDAQ:TER) exceeds Q3 expectations but stock drops
news.summary: Semiconductor testing company Teradyne (NASDAQ:TER) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with revenue up 69.8% year on year to $1.31 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $1.3 billion at the midpoint, 1.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.29 per share was 11.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
